subtitle.description: Magnetic physics bubble shooter game with dynamic attraction, rotors, and special balls.

bomb.name: Bomb
bomb.tooltip: Detonates magnetic balls in a wide blast radius

rainbow.name: Prism
rainbow.tooltip: Matches any adjacent magnetic ball color

anvil.name: Anvil
anvil.tooltip: Pierces and crushes every ball in its path

freeze.name: Cryo
freeze.tooltip: Freezes descent and stabilizes magnetic oscillation

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.tooltip: Fires three homing rockets at the hardest spheres on the board

button.buyAria: {{name}}: none left. Open the Workshop to buy more

label.pointer: Game board. Aim with the mouse, then fine-tune with the Left/Right arrows (Shift for bigger steps), shoot with a click or Enter, swap with Space.
label.touch: Game board. Drag on the board to aim, release to shoot, tap the launcher to swap.

round.fluxStageCleared: Shape {{stage}} cleared. The next shape is coming.

wave.goldRush: GOLD RUSH WAVE! Bonus Coin Cores!

tutorial.pendulum: Match 3+ same-color balls or sever upper anchors to trigger a magnetic avalanche!
tutorial.rotor: The central rotor spins dynamically from ball weight balance and shot impact torque.
tutorial.repulsor: Repulsive cores and like magnetic poles bend your shot: trust the curved laser!
tutorial.portal: Shoot into a Quantum Portal to teleport your projectile past moving barriers!
tutorial.boss: Boss Cores (👑) have 3 shields and burst into a shower of coins when destroyed!
tutorial.laserLock: Destroy all Lock Cores (🔒) to disable the energy barrier!
tutorial.singularity: Avalanche balls pulled into the Singularity Vortex grant bonus points & Overcharge!
tutorial.neutralAnchor: Gray anchors (⚓) never break in a match: cut the spheres around them, and they crumble once nothing hangs from them!
tutorial.chained: Chained spheres (⛓) never snap loose when stretched: blast them with a bomb, or destroy the spheres they hold!
tutorial.bubble: Bubbled spheres (◌) cannot join a group: hit them, or clear a group next to them, to pop the bubble!
tutorial.cores: Colored cores go off when their group is destroyed: ❄ freezes, ⚡ strikes the row, 🎨 repaints the neighbors!
tutorial.rail: Rail anchors slide along their track: clear one side and the weight of the other drags the anchor!
tutorial.thruster: Thrusters (⏫) push their cluster up: destroy them and the cluster sags toward the danger line!
tutorial.tether: Tether spheres (∿) hold distant spheres with long links that never snap: cut the tether sphere to drop them!
tutorial.rust: Rust (⚙) blocks every group: blast it, drop it, or paint it. Rockets (🚀) seek out the hardest targets!

specialAmmo.title: Special Ammo Refill (Current Run)
specialAmmo.unavailableHint: Start a level, Survival, Daily or Flux run to buy ammo.

armored.name: Armored Sphere
armored.description: Requires 2 matches or blasts to shatter.

dormantBomb.name: Dormant Barrel
dormantBomb.description: Detonates when destroyed, blasting nearby cluster balls.

chameleon.name: Chameleon Sphere
chameleon.description: Cycles its magnetic color after every turn.

coinCore.name: Coin Core
coinCore.description: Awards bonus coins when matched or dropped in an avalanche.

bossCore.name: Boss Core
bossCore.description: Protected by 3 shields. Bursts into a massive coin and score bounty.

laserLock.name: Quantum Lock
laserLock.description: Destroy all Lock Cores in the level to disable energy barriers.

neutralAnchor.name: Neutral Anchor
neutralAnchor.description: A gray anchor no match can break. Bombs, lightning and the anvil remove it, and it crumbles once nothing hangs from it.

chained.name: Chained Sphere
chained.description: Its links never snap when stretched. Only an explosion, or destroying a linked sphere, sets it free.

bubble.name: Bubble Sphere
bubble.description: Cannot join a group until its bubble pops: hit it, or destroy a group right next to it.

freezeCore.name: Freeze Core
freezeCore.description: Freezes the spheres around it for a few turns when destroyed.

lightningCore.name: Lightning Core
lightningCore.description: Strikes its whole row with lightning when destroyed.

paintCore.name: Paint Core
paintCore.description: Repaints nearby spheres in its color when destroyed, setting up new groups.

thruster.name: Thruster Sphere
thruster.description: Pushes upward against gravity, lifting the spheres bonded to it away from the danger line.

tether.name: Tether Sphere
tether.description: Binds to spheres farther away with long links that never snap. Long links hold weight but never join a color group.

rust.name: Rusted Sphere
rust.description: Colorless and inert: it never joins a group. Explosions, rockets, the anvil and avalanches remove it, and a Paint Core scrubs it back to a color.

pivot.name: Inertia Rotor
pivot.description: Spins dynamically based on cluster weight balance and shot impact torque.

bumper.name: Energy Bumper
bumper.description: Ricochets projectiles at high speed for trick bank shots.

repulsor.name: Repulsor Core
repulsor.description: Pushes and bends projectile trajectories passing through its field.

attractor.name: Gravity Well
attractor.description: Pulls and curves projectile trajectories toward its center.

barrier.name: Oscillating Barrier
barrier.description: Moving shield that blocks direct shots. Can be disabled via Quantum Locks.

portal.name: Quantum Portals
portal.description: Teleports projectiles instantaneously to the linked exit portal with a speed boost.

singularity.name: Singularity Vortex
singularity.description: Absorbs falling avalanche balls for bonus score and Overcharge.

firstAvalanche.name: Avalanche Master
firstAvalanche.description: Drop at least 6 unanchored balls in a single avalanche.

comboMaster.name: Chain Resonance
comboMaster.description: Reach a x4 or higher Combo multiplier.

bossSlayer.name: Crown Breaker
bossSlayer.description: Destroy a Boss Core (👑) in Campaign, Survival or Flux Mode.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: Clear any campaign level with at least 12 shots remaining.

starCollector.name: Magnetic Constellation
starCollector.description: Earn a total of 18 stars across Campaign levels.

laserSight.name: Curved Laser Sight
laserSight.description: Increases predictive aiming distance and wall bounces.

blastRadius.name: Magnetic Amplifier
blastRadius.description: Increases the area of effect of Bomb, Lightning, and Cryo balls.

overchargeRate.name: Overcharge Capacitor
overchargeRate.description: Fills the Overcharge gauge faster to earn free Special Balls.

startingShots.name: Projectile Reserve
startingShots.description: Adds +2 starting shots per rank in all campaign levels.

reason.lineCrossed: The magnetic cluster crossed the danger threshold.
reason.outOfShots: You ran out of magnetic projectiles.

aim.pointer: Aim & Shoot: move the mouse, click to shoot
aim.touch: Aim & Shoot: drag on the board, release to shoot

swap.pointer: Swap Projectile: click the launcher or press Space
swap.touch: Swap Projectile: tap the launcher or the Swap button

cancel.pointer: Cancel a shot: release the click below the launcher
cancel.touch: Cancel a shot: drag back below the launcher before releasing

instructions.keyboard: Keyboard: Left/Right to Fine-Tune Aim (Shift: Faster), Enter to Shoot, F to Flip Polarity, 1-6 for Special Balls
instructions.physics: Tip: Sever anchor links or unbalance rotors to trigger chain reactions!

confirm.message: Your current progress in this round will be lost.

lvl1.name: Magnetic Pendulum
lvl1.description: Experience dynamic attraction and swing the suspended cluster.

lvl2.name: Inertia Rotor
lvl2.description: A central rotor spins based on ball weight balance and impact torque.

lvl3.name: Dual Anchors & Bumpers
lvl3.description: Bank your shots off energy bumpers to sever the upper anchors.

lvl4.name: Repulsive Anomaly
lvl4.description: A repulsive core bends projectile trajectories. Follow the curved laser!

lvl5.name: Oscillating Citadel
lvl5.description: Moving barriers guard armored spheres and dormant explosive barrels.

lvl6.name: Binary Vortex
lvl6.description: Twin inertia rotors paired with a gravitational attraction field.

lvl7.name: Hexagonal Hive
lvl7.description: A dense hexagonal matrix filled with chameleon balls and coin cores.

lvl8.name: Gravitational Spiral
lvl8.description: Four spiral arms rotating freely around a magnetic core.

lvl9.name: Tesla Cross
lvl9.description: A rotating cross guarded by bumpers and explosive barrels.

lvl10.name: Omega Core
lvl10.description: Twin armored rotors guarded by an oscillating barrier and Boss Cores.

lvl11.name: Quantum Rift
lvl11.description: Shoot through linked magnetic portals to bypass the oscillating shield.

lvl12.name: Sovereign Singularity
lvl12.description: The final showdown: twin rotors, dimensional portals, and Boss Cores.

lvl13.name: Quantum Locks
lvl13.description: Destroy all Lock Cores to disable the oscillating energy shield.

lvl14.name: Singularity Well
lvl14.description: Feed falling magnetic avalanches into twin gravitational vortices.

lvl15.name: Orbital Prism
lvl15.description: Five spiral arms guarded by portals, laser locks, and a central singularity.

lvl16.name: Absolute Nexus
lvl16.description: Master the ultimate magnetic matrix of Boss Cores, portals, and twin singularities.

lvl17.name: Gray Moorings
lvl17.description: Neutral anchors hold the cluster: work around what you cannot break.

lvl18.name: Iron Links
lvl18.description: Chained spheres refuse to snap loose. Bring explosives.

lvl19.name: Bubble Field
lvl19.description: Pop the bubbles before their spheres can join a match.

lvl20.name: Core Reactor
lvl20.description: Freeze, lightning and paint cores turn one match into a chain reaction.

lvl21.name: Sliding Rails
lvl21.description: Two anchors ride rails: unbalance the cluster to drag them aside.

lvl22.name: Lift Off
lvl22.description: Thrusters hold the cluster high. Shoot them down to bring it within reach.

lvl23.name: Long Tethers
lvl23.description: Long links reach across the gaps. Find the sphere that holds them all.

lvl24.name: Rust Belt
lvl24.description: Rust chokes every group. Bring rockets, bombs and paint.
